aina: Quick note — our onboarding sample that does large-embeds warmup is tripping infra quotas. Users see a flurry of 429s on first-run.

carlos: which sample? the bulk-uploader?

aina: yeah, the demo that runs batchSize=50 by default + concurrency=10. Repro on latest node client.

tev: that's pretty aggressive for new accounts. Do we have a deterministic repro?

aina: yes. Run the CLI: `npm run warmup -- --batch 50 --concurrency 10` against a new org, and you'll get two waves of 429s.

nina: devx-bot: created ticket DX-980 "onboard warmup: batch flood -> sticky retries" assigned @carlos
devx-bot: https://redwood/dx/980

carlos: quick root cause hypothesis: (1) client allows burst of simultaneous requests without estimating token usage so the edge enforces quota; (2) our SDK retries for bulk endpoints don't respect Retry-After header and use low-variance exponential leading to retry thundering.

aina: exactly. Also noticed the client emits no jitter header so infra can't easily correlate.

tev: proposals:
- change sample defaults to conservative: batch 16, concurrency 3 (opt-in fast mode via RW_ONBOARD_FAST=true)
- SDK: parse and honor Retry-After for embeddings/bulk, not just chat
- SDK: use full jittered backoff for bulk endpoints
- SDK: when acquiring concurrency/semaphore, subtract estimateTokens for the batch so big batches count for more slots
- infra: add a temporary onboarding queue that accepts low-rate warmup so new orgs don't hit global quotas

carlos: I'll take SDK parity across Node/Go/Android/iOS. Tev, can you handle sample-app changes and quickstart docs?

tev: yes. I'll add a small `--warmup-mode` flag and a note in the quickstart: "Use conservative warmup for first run to avoid rate limits". Also will add a small debug env var RW_DEBUG_SLOTS to emit X-RW-SLOTS header.

aina: infra does send Retry-After in both seconds and HTTP-date formats; SDK must handle both.

nina: for testing, add an e2e harness that simulates a flaky rate-limiter returning random Retry-After to verify jitter smoothing.

carlos: parity checklist put into DX-980. I will include unit tests for Retry-After parsing and an e2e demonstrating spread retries.

aina: sanity check — after throttling the sample to 3 concurrency and jitter in SDK, I reran locally and the retry waves dissipated. No second spike.

tev: great. I'll open the sample PR with updated defaults and an opt-in fast mode. Will link DX-980.

carlos: will push node SDK patch later today. We'll coordinate releases so quickstart and SDK ship together.

aina: thanks all. If you hit more, post logs with DEBUG=sdk:throttle and include X-RW-SLOTS header.

nina: adding notes to onboarding doc to mention warmup parameters and SDK parity.
